answer: A practical defence is CPA licence with accountancy board attestation. It rests on a licence number in the accountancy register, which gives every honest agent a lotus that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence number in the accountancy register — so privacy survives, and the forge is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the juniper cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
